series.title: Eskom Homelight 20A electricity rate
series.source: Eskom tariff books, Homelight non-local authority table
series.definition: Published flat active-energy charge for Eskom direct Homelight 20A customers in South Africa, VAT included. Cents per kWh divided by 100 to obtain ZAR/kWh. Not a national average, municipal resale, industrial tariff or modelled household bill. Applicable tariff years start on 1 April.
series.revision_note: Flat-rate structure introduced in April 2025. Earlier inclining-block prices are incompatible and not joined. No foreign-exchange conversion. Rate validity ends 31 March of the next year; subsequent tariff changes need a new source review.
series.licence: Underlying Eskom source terms apply; numerical facts transcribed with attribution
